Subject: Promo consolidation ask — two cohorts / tax question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick one: NeuroHub ran in two different accelerators this spring (May cohort with Lumen Labs and a June regional program). Both cohorts gave us Redwood promo credits (separate promo codes tied to each program). We have limited runway and would like to consolidate those credits so we can use the total against a Dedicated pool while we evaluate long-term capacity.

Two specific questions:
- Eligibility: can Redwood consolidate credits issued under two different promo codes / cohorts into a single prepaid balance? If not, is there an exception path?
- Tax/invoicing: our finance team needs any credit consolidation documented as a service/invoice for accounting — will Redwood issue an invoice for the consolidated value (we're US-registered but have an EU entity; we can share VAT/Tax IDs)?

Attached is the incubator acceptance letter and the promo code screenshots (incubator-proof.pdf). If consolidation is possible we'll need confirmation for our sponsor and the accelerator legal team.

Appreciate any guidance. If it's easier, we can hop on a quick call.

Best,

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear note and the attachment.

Short answer: we can consider an exception but there are a couple of eligibility and finance checks we need to run. To speed things up I attached a short checklist — consolidation-checklist.xlsx — that our finance and partner ops team uses. Quick items we need from you:
- Confirmation that both promo codes were applied to accounts under the same legal entity (or authorization from the sponsoring org to transfer).
- Sponsor confirmation (email or letter) that the accelerator approves pooling the promo value.
- Billing entity info: company legal name, EIN or VAT, and billing address (for invoicing).

Our typical policy is that promo credits are non-transferable between independent legal entities. Exception paths exist when: a) credits originate from a partner-sponsored program and the sponsor signs off, or b) internal commercial approves on a case-by-case basis. If you can supply the checklist items we'll triage with finance and legal.

On the invoicing / tax side: Redwood's finance team can issue an invoice for the consolidated value if the credits are converted to a prepaid balance or we agree to apply a writeoff + invoice pairing. That said, VAT treatment depends on the jurisdiction and whether you're asking for taxed consideration versus a promotional write-off — finance will need the billing entity and tax IDs.

Next steps I propose:
1) You fill out the attached checklist and send the sponsor confirmation (Lumen Labs legal ok).
2) I'll route to Finance (cc'd: Ben) and Legal (cc'd: Vivek) for signoff — Ben will own the commercial terms.
3) If approved, we'll draft a short consolidation terms addendum for signatures.

Happy to take a 20-min call if that makes it easier.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Jordan / Kimberly — looping in commercial & finance next steps. I reviewed the checklist and the sponsor confirmation Lumen sent. Given both promos are tied to the same legal entity and Lumen has approved pooling, commercial is comfortable issuing an exception for consolidation with the following guardrails: 

1) Consolidation cap: up to $25,000 of promo value convertible to a Redwood prepaid balance (one-time conversion).
2) Documentation: Redwood will issue an invoice for the consolidated value (we treat the conversion as a taxable consideration where applicable). NeuroHub must provide a PO or formal purchase authorization and the billing details you already provided.
3) Terms: we'll prepare a short addendum (attached: consolidation-terms-draft.pdf) that records the sponsor signoff and the conversion mechanics (no cash payout; credits apply only to Redwood services).
4) Timing: finance requires a signed addendum + PO within 30 days of approval; after that we'll issue the invoice and apply the prepaid balance to your account.

If that works for you, Kimberly / Laura can circulate the addendum for signatures. Jordan — please upload the sponsor signed note and confirm PO timing. Happy to join a call if you want to run through the mechanics.

Thanks,
